name: virtual-resource-console
description: Cross-platform virtualization resource overview and recovery analysis console.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --workspace apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n api,web,electron -c green,cyan,magenta "npm --workspace apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:3987 tcp:5173 && npm --workspace apps/electron run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.pack:electron: npm run build && npm --workspace apps/electron run pack
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm --workspace apps/electron run dist:mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm --workspace apps/electron run dist:win
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
